items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The designer was Reid...I'm not sure. [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Reid Miles.

ctx.x: Those were a different kind of blowing session. Those were for Blue Note. Alfred Lion really liked to have a little rehearsal. He didn't like to take too many chances on stuff. You'd bring in some songs but if at all possible he'd like to have at least one rehearsal. Even if it was going to be an hour before the date he liked to have them maybe the day before or something like that, but even if it was sometime before they started recording he wanted to make sure you guys rehearsed the stuff to make sure the lines…
Yeah, so they were able to get some Warhol covers. Are these Art Blakey and Bobby Timmons and all that?
